title: Generate deterministic SBOM and supply-chain evidence
goal: Generate deterministic standards-oriented component inventory and provenance evidence from supported dependency manifests without claiming components that cannot be resolved.
inputs: development tooling may be external only when reviewed/pinned and must not become product runtime dependencies
invariants: security findings never expose secret material in CI logs
tooling does not silently become a product runtime dependency
a gate is activated only in the same change that proves its implementation
security_properties: fail closed on ambiguous security evidence
no production/customer data leaves the repository/build boundary
tool identity/version/provenance is explicit when external tooling is used
acceptance_tests: adaptive engineering-kernel succeeds in push and PR
security-gate audit succeeds with truthful readiness

performance_budget.rationale: fast source security controls must remain PR-suitable
metrics: fast gate execution remains bounded and change-aware

rollback.strategy: revert the sublot and return its security gate to specified without claiming active enforcement
verification: security-gate audit and adaptive kernel remain green

definition_of_ready: implementation scope is one coherent security behavior
definition_of_done: SBOM component identity is deterministic and tied to source SHA
unknown package ecosystems fail or remain explicitly unsupported rather than disappearing
SEC-SBOM-001 and applicable supply-chain gate activate only after evidence validation
